name: D7 Webform Import
description: Import webforms exported from Drupal 7 sites (requires the Webform module).
project_description: D7 Webform Import is a submodule of D7 Content Import (d7_import). It imports Drupal 7 Webform (7.x-4.x) forms into Drupal 11 as standalone Webform config entities. Given the webforms.xml file produced by the parent module's export script, its WebformImporter service recreates each D7 webform as a Webform entity: D7 components are mapped to D11 webform elements, fieldsets keep their nested children, D7 pagebreaks become webform_wizard_page containers, form settings (confirmation message/redirect, submit label, submission limits, preview, draft) are translated, and each row in the D7 {webform_emails} table becomes a D11 Webform email handler with excluded_components resolved from cid list to element keys. Submissions, conditional logic, and per-role access are not imported. It requires drupal/webform and the base d7_import module, and exposes two Drush commands (d7-import:webforms, d7-import:webforms-purge); d7-import:all in the parent module also runs the webform stage when this submodule is enabled and webforms.xml is present.
